_comment: Argon2 hashes produced by the Python backend (app.core.security.hash_password, argon2-cffi PasswordHasher defaults). The Java Argon2PasswordEncoder must verify every one of these. Regenerate only if the Python hashing parameters change.
java_encoder_construction: new Argon2PasswordEncoder(saltLength=16, hashLength=32, parallelism=4, memory=65536, iterations=3) -- Spring's defaults are parallelism=1, memory=16384, iterations=2 and would write weaker hashes than the existing corpus.
